title: Reading Drill — Testing a tool-cleaning station — Preparing a second trial
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Testing a tool-cleaning station — Preparing a second trial
passages.body:
**A** In Millcross, work on workers returning tools before cleaning off dirt had already produced a small collection of end-of-day checks. The site workshop manager used this material to plan a second trial. The first report contained several different figures, but for the second trial the group agreed to publish one main outcome: dirt on returned tools.

**B** The group kept a cleaning point by the return box for the new trial, which was planned to run for three weeks. Volunteers were shown a sample record before starting. They were also asked to describe anything unusual in a separate note, so later readers could tell the difference between an ordinary value and one taken during a disruption.

**C** The trial design stated that unusually busy shifts should be recorded even when everything else appeared normal. If this information was missing, the team would leave the field blank rather than infer an answer. It would publish a provisional finding and label it clearly if too few readings were available for a reliable result.
